name: PR Brief: seeded brief on the Overview tab, Review focus link deep-links into Files changed
description: AC-BRIEF-44, AC-BRIEF-41. Needs the seeded fresh PR Brief for PR #482 (server/src/db/seed-brief.ts, called by seed.ts): summary SEED_BRIEF_SUMMARY, two risks, two Review focus items src/middleware/ratelimit.ts:12 and src/config.ts:12, fresh against the default risk_brief model. Part 1: the Overview tab of PR #482 shows the stored brief (summary, a risk title, the 'REVIEW FOCUS (2)' heading (rendered uppercase by CSS)) with no review, no import and no LLM call (the card only GETs /pulls/:id/brief). Part 2: clicking the first focus link navigates to the Files changed tab with file= and line=12 in the URL; the seeded files have no patches, so line 12 is not a rendered line and the focus-missing-line notice is shown (this is the e2e proof for AC-BRIEF-41; forced expansion of an oversized file is covered by the DiffTab/FileCard RTL tests). The flow is read-only: the Generate and Refresh buttons are never clicked.
